full_details: In the morning the folded sheet was still five lines and no speech. At four you walked with the wind behind you and said the names. Romeus, then Romeo in three beats that open at the end. Juliet, Montague, Capulet, Capel. Mercutio has a cold hand in Brooke and nothing else. A laundress's cart passed. Tybalt is a cat's name. You stopped. The king at home, with his uncles, will not wait. At night you wrote NOT YET under the names. No line of either play was spoken.
one_sentence: You tried Verona's names aloud on the Moorfields path and left the king on the board as a shape.
title: Said the Verona names on the Moorfields path
